CustomField.description: The ROLE accountable for this item, mirroring Transaction_Task_Def__mdt.Owner_Label__c and falling back to the group label when the item has none. NOT A USER AND NOT A RECORD OWNER - a master-detail child has no OwnerId. The real person who completed the item is Completed_By__c. Do not render this next to Completed_DateTime__c as completed by role.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The role accountable for this item, for example CFO or Legal. It is a label, not a Salesforce user.
